guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: checkoutservice shows the largest anomalies in the digest: memory rose about 19x (z=+375) and CPU rose about 45x (z=+220), with latency-90 up 764% and latency-50 up 456%. Its downstream callees (paymentservice, emailservice, currencyservice) are essentially flat, so the slowdown originates in checkoutservice itself; the logs contain no warnings or errors to separate cpu from mem, and I chose cpu because the CPU series is the more extreme saturation signal (18.6 vs a 0.41 baseline).

proposed_fix.description: Restart or scale out checkoutservice (add replicas/CPU limits) to relieve saturation, then profile it for the CPU and memory growth (e.g. a runaway loop or leak) before the next deploy.
